Built for bold performance and rugged capability, the 2024 Ram 1500 Classic Warlock RWD is now available at Kia of Orange Park. Finished with aggressive styling and powered by a dependable 3.6L V6 24V VVT engine paired with an 8-Speed Automatic transmission, this truck delivers the strength you need for work and the comfort you want for everyday driving. With its signature Warlock styling and advanced features, this Ram 1500 Classic is ready to tackle the road ahead.

FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS & BENEFITS

LIFETIME POWERTRAIN WARRANTY
Drive with confidence knowing your engine, transmission, and drivetrain components are protected for as long as you own the vehicle.

PARKSENSE REAR PARKASSIST SYSTEM
Sensors help detect obstacles behind you and provide alerts, making parking and backing up safer and easier.

SENTRY KEY THEFT DETERRENT SYSTEM
Advanced anti-theft technology helps prevent unauthorized vehicle access and adds an extra layer of security.

ELECTRONIC STABILITY CONTROL
Helps maintain vehicle stability during sudden turns or slippery conditions by automatically adjusting engine power and braking.

5INCH TOUCH SCREEN DISPLAY
Easy-to-use infotainment interface that allows quick access to audio, vehicle settings, and media controls.

MEDIA HUB WITH USB AND AUXILIARY PORT
Connect your smartphone or music device to enjoy your favorite playlists while keeping devices charged on the go.

REARVIEW DAY/NIGHT MIRROR
Automatically adjusts to reduce glare from headlights behind you, improving nighttime driving visibility.

REMOTE KEYLESSENTRY WITH ALLSECURE
Unlock and lock your truck conveniently without removing the key from your pocket or bag.

LOCKING TAILGATE
Protects tools, cargo, and gear stored in the truck bed with added security.

POWERHEATED MIRRORS WITH FOLDAWAY
Heated mirrors improve visibility in cold or wet weather, while fold-away functionality helps prevent damage in tight spaces.

20INCH x 9.0INCH HIGHGLOSS BLACK ALUMINUM WHEELS
Bold, stylish wheels that enhance the trucks aggressive Warlock appearance while providing a strong and stable ride.

description: 2014 Ford F-150 XLT — Oxford White on Steel Gray cloth. A hardworking truck with a sense of humor and a clean CARFAX to prove it. Under the hood - 3.7L Flex Fuel V6 producing 302 hp and 278 lb-ft of torque — plenty of get-up-and-go for daily driving, towing light loads, or pretending you’re on a BBQ run for the entire neighborhood. - Flex Fuel capability (E85-ready), paired to a smooth 6-speed automatic transmission for dependable, predictable shifts. Exterior & presence - Oxford White paint that says “practical, but classy” — hides dust well and looks sharp next to a trailer or a latte. - XLT chrome appearance touches (grille and bumpers) that deliver that polished pickup look without trying too hard. - Alloy wheels and full-size spare, because adventures are better when they don’t involve roadside improvisation. Interior & comfort - Steel Gray cloth seating — durable, comfy, and mercifully stain-tolerant when life happens. - Supportive front seats with a practical center folding armrest/console for phones, snacks, and occasional napping (parked, of course). - Automatic climate control and strong A/C to keep things cool when the thermostat decides to be dramatic. - Tilt steering wheel with convenient audio and cruise controls right at your fingertips — less reaching, more driving. Technology & convenience - Ford SYNC infotainment with Bluetooth hands-free calling and audio streaming — because yelling at your phone is so last decade. - AM/FM/CD with auxiliary and USB inputs for playlists, podcasts, and the occasional jam session. - Power windows, power door locks, and remote keyless entry for the civilized unlocking of doors. - Cruise control for highway cruising and pretending the commute isn’t a grind. Safety & reliability - Four-wheel ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control to help keep things headed in the right direction. - Multiple airbags (front and side/curtain protection) and a Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) for safety checks that actually mean something. - Clean CARFAX report — no surprises, no skeletons, just straightforward history. Mileage & condition - Below 128,000 miles overall, averaging less than 10,000 miles per year — proof it’s been used responsibly, not abused. - Excellent overall condition inside and out — truck ready to work, weekend, or commute duty without drama. Bottom line in case you scrolled to the end This 2014 F-150 XLT is a dependable, well-equipped pickup with the muscular-but-manners-ready 3.7L Flex Fuel V6, practical factory features, clean history, and mileage that makes it a smart value. The **2020 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 Fastback** is a stunning representation of American muscle, equipped with the **Technology Package**, **Handling Package**, and **Equipment Group 950A**. This certified powerhouse is driven by a robust 5.2L V-8 DOHC engine, producing an astonishing 760 horsepower paired with a TREMEC 7-speed auto-shift manual transmission. This exceptional performance car is not just about raw power, it’s about a comprehensive driving experience that emphasizes technology, safety, and comfort.

With the **Technology Package**, drivers can enjoy heated side mirrors and remote activated perimeter approach lighting that enhance visibility and convenience. The integrated navigation system with voice activation ensures you reach your destination effortlessly, while the Ford Co-Pilot360 features, including the Blind Spot Information System BLIS and Cross-Traffic Alert, bolster safety on the road. The three memory settings for door mirrors allow multiple drivers to personalize their space, ensuring comfort for everyone behind the wheel.

The **Handling Package** further refines the GT500s performance, offering enhanced agility and responsiveness that true driving enthusiasts crave. Meanwhile, the **Equipment Group 950A** provides essential equipment that enhances overall enjoyment and functionality, making this vehicle as practical as it is exhilarating.

Among its standout features, smart device mirroring prioritizes connectivity, allowing drivers to operate their smartphones seamlessly through the vehicles infotainment system. With the mobile hotspot feature, passengers can remain connected to the internet throughout their journey without tapping into their own data plans.

Safety is paramount in the GT500, highlighted by its rear camera which enhances visibility for parking and navigating tight spaces. The brake assist feature is invaluable, providing additional stopping power during emergency situations.

Comfort is equally prioritized with ventilated front seats and heated cushions for the driver and front passenger, ensuring a pleasant ride in all weather conditions. The luxurious leather seat upholstery adds a touch of class, making every journey memorable.

In conclusion, the 2020 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 Fastback is not just a vehicle, its a thrilling blend of power, advanced technology, and luxurious comfort, making it a must-have for any automotive enthusiast. Don’t miss your chance to experience this iconic muscle car!

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

As a Certified Pre-Owned model with a Clean CARFAX and only one previous owner, it has undergone a rigorous 165+ point inspection. You are getting a machine that looks and drives like it just rolled off the assembly line, backed by the confidence that only a Mercedes-Benz certification can provide.

The exterior of this CLE 53 AMG Coupe is dressed to impress with the AMG Night Package, which adds sleek High-Gloss Black elements for a more aggressive look. It sits perfectly on 20 inch AMG Multi-Spoke Y-Design wheels with black accents that pop against the vibrant blue paint. Whether you are cruising downtown or hitting the open road, the adaptive suspension ensures this CLE 53 AMG Coupe handles every curve with absolute precision and grace.

Step inside the cabin and you will find a driver focused environment that does not skim on comfort. The interior features sporty MB-Tex and Microfiber upholstery accented by bold red stitching and a Piano Black Lacquer center console. You will stay cool during the summer with ventilated front seats, while the Panorama power moonroof lets in plenty of natural light. Every detail in this CLE 53 AMG Coupe is designed to make you feel like you are in a high-end cockpit, from the leather sport steering wheel to the memory seats that remember your exact preferences.

Technology is front and center in this CLE 53 AMG Coupe, highlighted by a massive 11.9 inch center touchscreen display. With wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, your favorite apps and playlists are always just a tap away. The MBUX navigation system makes finding your destination easier than ever, while the SiriusXM w/360L provides endless entertainment options. This CLE 53 AMG Coupe even looks out for you with an auto-dimming rearview mirror and an exterior parking camera to make tight spots a breeze.

The performance of this CLE 53 AMG Coupe is truly matched by its incredible sound. With a premium system featuring 15 speakers, your music will come to life with crystal clear quality. Between the raw power of the 3.0L I6 Turbo engine and the 4MATIC all-wheel drive system, every trip becomes an event. This CLE 53 AMG Coupe is the ultimate choice for anyone who wants a car that is as smart as it is fast.
